dedupe_keys.name: nist supply chain traceability for agri food manufacturing sct4afm grain traceability ontology and synthetic datasets

description: Information models and synthetic data for tracing grain through the agri-food supply chain. The GitHub repository says it holds a machine-readable semantic model (ontology) of the entities and tracking events needed for grain production traceability, meant to show stakeholders what data must be collected and where standards have gaps, and synthetic datasets generated by simulation of traceability events in grain supply chains for testing traceability models and applications. The repository is a free public download, was archived on 12 June 2026 and is read-only, with the last ontology update in July 2021. Coverage is generic grain supply chains. Caveats: it is archived and no longer maintained, and the licence file was not read. For simulation it gives an event model and synthetic traces to test how quickly contaminated or disrupted grain lots can be located along a supply chain. A related catalogue record is the FIBO financial industry ontology.
